title: Inferno Core
description: The core mod for the Mephisto's Inferno SMP
body:
# NOTICE
**THIS MOD IS NO LONGER IN DEVELOPMENT AND NEITHER IS THE SERVER**

# Inferno Core

This is the mod for the Mephisto's Inferno SMP, it implements all the core features on the server: Roles, Mana, Semi-Hardcore.

## WARNING

**This mod is made specifically for the server and its players there is no guarantee that it will work in other environments. It is usable but not fully funcional in singleplayer.**
